This map-only regression fixture is a captured real `/api/compare` result for the verified City Thaden Field House airport visitor point → City Library point on 2026-10-24 UTC. Provider geometry, metrics, labels and provenance are retained. The infrastructure array is omitted to keep the fixture small; the test checks endpoint-label framing against the legend, rather than coverage calculation. It is imported only by a Playwright test and never by application runtime code.
